description.value:
As a scion of House Cannith, you carry a proud legacy. Cannith builds the wonders of the modern world, and you are expected to contribute to the house's success through invention, scholarship, trade, or diplomacy. The only obstacle is the deep rift within your own house: the sooner its three barons settle which of them truly leads it (and you surely have your favorite), the sooner House Cannith can take its rightful place at the head of the dragonmarked houses.

Ability Scores: Strength, Dexterity, Intelligence

Feat: @UUID[Compendium.compendium-owidyn.backgrounds-feats.Item.CJDDZw1KFFulkdmY]{Mark of Making}

Skill Proficiencies: Investigation and Sleight of Hand

Tool Proficiency: Choose one kind of Artisan's Tools

Equipment: Choose A or B: (A) Artisan's Tools (same as above), @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagCrowbar0000]{Crowbar}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagClothesFine]{Fine Clothes}, 2 @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagPouch000000]{Pouches}, 17 GP; or (B) 50 GP
